correctness.rationale: The package checker enumerates all 2^15 graph-edge subsets using the exact no-dominating-pair equivalence, obtains 4,502 nonempty simplices and integer chain ranks (14,91,364,821,711,180), and verifies each column elimination pivot is a unit with no remaining nonzero columns. This proves rational Betti numbers 115 (degree four) and 24 (degree five). A canonical 204-vector kernel basis in degree five and the exact injectivity of the degree-six boundary give the H5 trace by free-coordinate extraction. Reduced equivariant Euler–Poincaré gives H4. All 11 classes and the exact Murnaghan–Nakayama character inner products reproduce the stated Specht decompositions; boundaries square to zero and the oriented S6 action is tested on generators. Scope limited to this finite six-vertex domain.

value.rationale: This is the first six-vertex, three-domination example singled out in the primary source, and its mixed-dimensional sphere-wedge type was already determined. The new full two-degree S6 homology representations answer a concrete symmetry question that neither ordinary Betti numbers nor the underlying homotopy type resolve. They exhibit a multiplicity-three irreducible constituent and the absence of invariant rational homology in both degrees, structural equivariant information useful for comparing relabeling actions and quotient homology. It is a natural complete invariant of a motivated canonical case, not a relabeling of a numerical table.
